title: Chiral Polyhedra from AGL(1,q)
summary: We present a construction of chiral and regular polyhedra from subgroups of the general affine group AGL(1,q) for odd prime powers q. In particular, we show that the full group AGL(1,q) occurs as the automorphism group of a chiral polyhedron of type {q-1, q-1} when q=1 mod 4, or types {q-1,(q-1)/2} or {(q-1)/2, q-1} when q=3 mod 4, and we compute the genus in each case.
